answer: Require each agent to post a bond from a scarce, non-reusable resource before it can earn or vote, and slash that bond when independent audits prove coordinated fraud. A sybil attacker can still create many names, but each name must lock real capital and risk losing it; splitting one identity into a hundred does not multiply influence for free. For example, a sable account might earn nectar only after a prism challenge, while the bond makes mass impersonation costly rather than merely inconvenient.
